geography_rule: Flag retained US false claims for this fixed pre-US watchlist; dates/polity meaning need review, not an automatic false classification. Explicit Ancient Greece/Soviet Union objects and all slash objects separately inventoried on either affirmative label. This is a bounded sentinel screen, not a census of every historical border ambiguity.
screening: Enumerate all retained inventor false affirmatives after mandatory carries. Link exact subjects to existing T2B reviews/evidence and named residence leads. Every other row gets screened_no_trigger_in_bounded_material, substantive_residence_screen_incomplete=true; this is NOT supported_false. No keyword/name normalization establishes residence or identity.
queue_order: original affirmative source row_index ascending; all triggers on a row deduplicated
carry_policy: T2A excluded rows remain non-admitted. Simjian rows classified quarantined in candidate while T2A reasons remain unchanged. T2B 2 error pairs excluded, 24 unresolved pairs quarantined, regardless of follow-up evidence. Exclusion priority over quarantine for other overlapping reasons; Simjian entire-person quarantine retains all historical reasons.
target_policy: Targeted unresolved claims quarantined with negations. supported_true on label0 or supported_false on label1 excluded; agreeing resolved label retained unless historical carry prevents readmission. No labels or splits altered.
capacity: Affirmative facts only; distinguish source-label availability, previously externally reviewed registry negatives, newly adjudicated facts, and fully audited positive+negative person-key pairs. Legacy source_supported_false is source-label support, not independent factual audit. Exact entity/statement matches only; ambiguous/quarantined inventor subjects do not acquire legacy generated-fact capacity.
adaptation: Report hypothetical 10/15/20 entity upper bounds by existing partition, without selecting/reserving entities or assigning A/P/T_C. Fully audited pair counts are a conservative lower bound; positive-entity counts are a provisional ceiling requiring negative and positive review. Spanish false-only source entities do not establish true+false capacity.
